title: Renewal Calendar Event Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Renewal calendar events (`calendar:event`), Rocket Money subscriptions (`rocketmoney:subscription`), Stripe invoices (`stripe:invoice`), and Google Workspace licenses (`googleworkspace:license`).
app: Renewal calendar exports, Rocket Money subscriptions, Stripe invoice history, and Google Workspace license data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=calendar:event
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by vendor_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when renewal calendar event data has stopped arriving for a given vendor name.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per vendor name and alert when the feed is older than 168 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when one part of your renewal calendar event feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
